conflicts.summary: The May 28 system card records release-time RSP v3.3; the current governance baseline is RSP v3.4 effective July 8. The historical release basis is not rewritten.
RSP v3.4 mixes stronger public redaction marking with narrower guaranteed unredacted staff access, permissible publication lag, and section-split external review.
Anthropic published a detailed June Fable safeguard follow-up, while this pass found no direct primary remediation account for the separate April Mythos vendor-environment report.
Prompted, frame-sensitive, and training-shaped welfare evidence warrants monitoring but does not satisfy the assessment method's Rung 3 developmental trigger.
